items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I got Johnny, I found Johnny at Dotts working in the Roseville. Every 12 o'clock he used to blow his clarinet in the gutter.

ctx.x: What's Bad Frank? Bad Frank had a brother out there, two players. Yeah, I'll see. I'll see. Yeah, yeah, yeah. The violin? I'll see Frank played violin. Yeah. That's who played with the boys. I'll see. I'll see Frank. I'll see Frank. I'll see Frank. I'll see Frank played violin.

Yeah. That's who went to play with the boys, by me, they let me go because I was a kid. I'll see Frank. That was Bad's brother. Yeah. Yeah. And they had the, let me see what other band they had up there. Johnny Brown? Well, Johnny Brown, that's Johnny Brown, that's Way of Lake. Way of Lake. Johnny Brown had a band.

He played, he learned how to play clarinet, see, when they went in the Oilers band, see. And I got Johnny, I found Johnny at Dotts working in the Roseville. Every 12 o'clock he used to blow his clarinet in the gutter. And I got Johnny, I found Johnny at Dotts working in the Roseville. Every 12 o'clock he used to blow his clarinet in the gutter. And I went down there, so. Where was he working? In the Roseville.
